path = 'rules_test.py'

new = '''# ---------------------------------------------------------------- validation
TOPO2 = {
    "nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 50},
              {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 50}],
    "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 50}],
    "external_nodes": ["A", "B"],
}
counter_set = {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 10},
               "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 10},
               "low_B_egress_to_A": {"perturbed": 3},
               "low_A_ingress_from_B": {"perturbed": 3},
               "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 10},
               "low_A_termination": {"perturbed": 3},
               "low_B_origination": {"perturbed": 3},
               "low_B_termination": {"perturbed": 10}}
demand_set = [[0, 1, 10], [1, 0, 3]]
flow = [patch(demand_set, counter_set), routes("l", PATHS), {"op": "repair", "id": "r"}]
clean = answers(flow, topo=TOPO2)

      conf[(0, 1)] == 5 and conf[(-1, 0)] == 3, json.dumps(conf))

for cut, expected in ([([0, 1], 8), ([3, 1], 8), ([3, 2], 8), ([4, 1], 4),
                      ([5, 1], 8), ([5, 2], 8), ([6, 1], 0), ([10, 2], 0)):
    ans = answers(flow + [{"op": "validate", "id": "r"}],
                  settings=dict(SETTINGS, cutoff=cut), topo=TOPO2)
    val = validates(ans)[0]
    check("cutoff %s selects %d cells" % (cut, expected), val["checked"] == expected,
          json.dumps(val))

# unreduced cutoff fractions behave identically
ans_a = answers(flow + [{"op": "validate", "id": "r"}],
                settings=dict(SETTINGS, cutoff=[4, 1]), topo=TOPO2)
ans_b = answers(flow + [{"op": "validate", "id": "r"}],
                settings=dict(SETTINGS, cutoff=[8, 2]), topo=TOPO2)
check("unreduced cutoff fractions agree",
      validates(ans_a)[0] == validates(ans_b)[0], json.dumps(validates(ans_b)[0]))

# demand change moves the expectation, not the frozen repair
after = flow + [patch([[0, 1, 20]], {}), {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}]
ans = answers(after, topo=TOPO2)
val = validates(ans)[0]
check("validation uses current demands against frozen values",
      val["checked"] == 8 and val["failed"] == ["low_A_egress_to_B", "low_A_origination",
                                                "low_B_ingress_from_A", "low_B_termination"]
      and val["passed"] == 4, json.dumps(val))
check("frozen repair is unchanged by the later patch",
      repairs(ans)[0]["links"] == repairs(clean)[0]["links"])

# the demand omission keeps its previous value
omit = flow + [patch([[1, 0, 7]], {}), {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}]
ans = answers(omit, topo=TOPO2)
check("patch omission preserves the preceding demand",
      validates(ans)[0]["failed"] == ["low_A_egress_to_B", "low_A_ingress_from_B",
                                      "low_A_origination", "low_B_termination",
                                      "low_B_egress_to_A", "low_B_ingress_from_A"],
      json.dumps(validates(ans)[0]))

# bias scaling of the expectation

              topo=TOPO2)
check("bias fully discounts the expectation", validates(ans)[0]["passed"] == 0,
      json.dumps(validates(ans)[0]))

# tau boundary: frozen 10 versus predicted 12 needs tau >= 166667 ppm
shift = flow + [patch([[0, 1, 12], [1, 0, 3]], {}), {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}]
ans = answers(shift, settings=dict(SETTINGS, tau=166667), topo=TOPO2)
check("tau tolerance is inclusive at the boundary",
      validates(ans)[0]["failed"] == [], json.dumps(validates(ans)[0]))
ans = answers(shift, settings=dict(SETTINGS, tau=166666), topo=TOPO2)
check("tau just below the boundary fails",
      validates(ans)[0]["failed"] == ["low_A_egress_to_B", "low_A_origination",
                                      "low_B_ingress_from_A", "low_B_termination"],
      json.dumps(validates(ans)[0]))

# zero expectation versus zero counter passes inclusively

                       {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 0}],
             "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 0}],
             "external_nodes": ["A", "B"]}
zero_flow = [patch([], {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 0},
                        "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 0},
                        "low_B_egress_to_A": {"perturbed": 0},
                        "low_A_ingress_from_B": {"perturbed": 0},
                        "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 0},
                        "low_A_termination": {"perturbed": 0},
                        "low_B_origination": {"perturbed": 0},
                        "low_B_termination": {"perturbed": 0}}),
             {"op": "routes", "label": "z", "paths": {"A": {"B": [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 1000}]},
                                                       "B": {"A": [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}]}}},
             {"op": "repair", "id": "z"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "z"}]
ans = answers(zero_flow, topo=zero_topo)
check("X=Y=0 passes", validates(ans)[0]["checked"] == 8 and
      validates(ans)[0]["passed"] == 8, json.dumps(validates(ans)[0]))

# gamma equality
ans = answers(flow + [patch([[0, 1, 20]], {}), {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}],
              settings=dict(SETTINGS, gamma=[1, 2]), topo=TOPO2)
val = validates(ans)[0]
ratio_ok = val["passed"] * 2 >= val["checked"]
check("gamma compares K/N inclusively", val["consistent"] == ratio_ok, json.dumps(val))
ans = answers(flow + [patch([[0, 1, 20]], {}), {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}],
              settings=dict(SETTINGS, gamma=[1, 1]), topo=TOPO2)
check("gamma 1 requires unanimity", validates(ans)[0]["consistent"] is False)

# null plan validation still expects external marginals only
null_plan = [patch(demand_set, counter_set), {"op": "routes", "label": "n", "paths": None},
             {"op": "repair", "id": "r"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}]

check("null plan validates only external expectations", val["checked"] == 4, json.dumps(val))

          {"op": "repair", "id": "e"}]
ans = answers(excess, topo=TOPO2)
row = [r for r in repairs(ans)[0]["links"] if r[0:2] == [0, 1]][0]
check("clamped prediction keeps the counter majority", row[2] == 10, json.dumps(row))

'''
